reuse_conditions: TDRA Open Data Policy: attribute TDRA, file name and publication date; share derived data under open-data principle; additional stated use restrictions apply. No standard named licence confirmed.
version: 2025 workbook; publisher release date not confirmed
fields_used: عدد المعاملات الإجمالي لعام 2025 — annual transaction count
transformation: Summary sheet rows retained with original Arabic labels and counts; surrounding whitespace trimmed. English service labels/questions are ModelFit-authored translations.

limitations: Counts only; no fees, eligibility, processing times, personal cases or AI policy obligations. Snapshot does not validate model behavior.
